title: EHang EH216-S certified passenger drone
summary: The first unmanned passenger aircraft to receive type certification for commercial operation.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The EH216-S received type certification from China's civil aviation authority in 2023, followed by production and airworthiness certificates, and has flown demonstration tourist routes. Certification covers the aircraft; airspace integration, vertiports and insurance remain unresolved. It is the clearest test of whether urban air mobility can become a service rather than a demonstration.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2023–2028
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Certification is a milestone, not a market; the constraint is ground infrastructure and operating rules.

What Would Change The View

  • Revenue-generating flight hours.
  • Route approvals outside trial zones.
  • Safety record as fleets grow.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
